count.description: Number of stereo sample pairs to capture.

encoding.description: Encoding used for the PCM sample payload.

volume.description: Desired SID master volume. Values outside 0-15 are clamped.

hard.description: If true, perform a hard register scrub; otherwise silence voices softly.

voice.description: SID voice to trigger (1-3). Limits depend on op.

note.description: Musical note like A4, C#5, or Bb3. Overrides frequencyHz if provided.

frequencyHz.description: Explicit frequency in Hz. Used when note is omitted.

waveform.description: SID waveform to enable. Limits depend on op.

pulseWidth.description: Pulse width (0-4095). Used for pulse waveform.

verify.description: When true, record audio after silencing to confirm the SID output is quiet. Limits depend on op.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the SID, PRG, or audio file.

songnr.description: Song number within the SID file (0-based index).

root.description: Root note for the arpeggio such as C4 or A#3.

preset.description: Optional musical preset to influence timing/expression. Limits depend on op.

sidwave.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

cpg.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

format.description: Source format hint when providing raw text.

output.description: Playback target format. PRG works on all backends; SID playback requires C64U/U64 or U2 (SID export with dryRun works everywhere).

dryRun.description: When true, skip playback and only return compilation metadata.

analysisDurationSeconds.description: Length of the verification recording on analyzable backends. Limits depend on op.

waitBeforeCaptureMs.description: Delay between starting playback and beginning verification capture. Limits depend on op.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

expectedSidwave.description: Optional expected SIDWAVE used to refine analysis comparisons. Limits depend on op.

verifySilenceBefore.description: Run silence verification before playback to ensure a quiet baseline.

verifySilenceAfter.description: Run silence verification after playback to ensure voices are released.

silenceDurationSeconds.description: Audio capture length used for silence verification.

silenceRmsThreshold.description: RMS threshold applied to silence verification captures.

postSilenceWaitMs.description: Delay between main analysis capture and the post-playback silence check (milliseconds).

silenceWaitMs.description: Delay between silencing the SID and recording during pre/post checks (milliseconds).

request.description: Natural language user request describing the verification goal.

durationSeconds.description: Override capture duration in seconds. Limits depend on op.

description:
Sound operations available via the c64_sound tool.

Operations:
- capture_samples [c64u]: Capture raw stereo PCM samples from the C64 Ultimate audio UDP stream. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: count, encoding.
- set_volume [write]: Set the SID master volume register at $D418 (0-15). Required inputs: volume.
- reset [write]: Soft or hard reset of SID registers to clear glitches. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: hard.
- note_on [write]: Trigger a SID voice with configurable waveform, ADSR, and pitch. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: voice, note, frequencyHz, system, waveform, pulseWidth, attack, decay, sustain, release.
- note_off [write]: Release a SID voice by clearing its gate bit. Required inputs: voice.
- silence_all [write]: Silence all SID voices with optional audio verification. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: verify.
- play_sid_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play a SID file stored on the Ultimate filesystem. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: songnr.
- play_mod_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play a MOD tracker module via the Ultimate SID player. Required inputs: path.
- generate [write]: Generate a lightweight SID arpeggio playback sequence. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: root, pattern, steps, tempoMs, waveform, preset.
- compile_play [write]: Compile SIDWAVE or CPG source and optionally play it immediately. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, format, output, dryRun.
- play_preset [write]: Compile and play a built-in SID preset such as Für Elise by Beethoven. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: preset, platforms, verify, analysisDurationSeconds, waitBeforeCaptureMs, restoreActiveBackend.
- pipeline [write]: Compile a SIDWAVE score, play it, and analyze the recording. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, output, waitBeforeCaptureMs, analysisDurationSeconds, expectedSidwave, verifySilenceBefore, verifySilenceAfter, silenceDurationSeconds, silenceRmsThreshold, postSilenceWaitMs, silenceWaitMs.
- analyze: Automatically analyze SID playback when verification is requested. Required inputs: request. Optional inputs: durationSeconds, expectedSidwave.
- record_analyze: Record audio for a fixed duration and return SID analysis metrics. Uses the Ultimate audio stream on c64u and the host microphone on other backends. Required inputs: durationSeconds. Optional inputs: expectedSidwave.
